claims.value: Twenty label-free synthetic model-peptide reaction assays covering five peptides and four chemical-treatment states each.
claims.evidence: Values were transcribed from the deposited project record, run manifest, sample sheet, and publication evidence listed above.

limitations: The custom psGSL reaction products do not have supported Unimod accessions in the deposited record, so modification parameters are conservatively `not available`.
Cleavage is `not applicable` because the deposited run-level sample list contains synthetic model peptides and the PRIDE preparation protocol describes direct peptide cleanup and LC-MS analysis.
